name: resource-req-v2
description: Interactive Gantt-style project requirements planner. Work-type-first layout: each trade is a coverage-gap band (deficit/surplus/covered/no-demand), now a continuous gradient line/area from a 0-baseline instead of numbered bars, over its source rows. Drag to create/resize/move requirement bars per source, with quantity popovers and optimistic UI. Colour reserved for the coverage band; source rows are monochrome with a category tick.
